svg.text: Implementation Set-Up Cost Scalability: Per-Patient Impact vs. NICE Appraisal Thresholds
Economic evaluation of one-off programme set-up costs across Initial Pilot (N = 120) and National NHS Rollout (N = 5,762/year) scenarios
A: Per-Patient Net NHS Cost (ΔC) & Net Monetary Benefit (NMB)
Downstream offsets (£776.50/pt) absorb setup costs up to £735.95; positive NMB persists up to £5,373.63/pt

B: ICER Trajectory vs. NICE Decision Thresholds (£/QALY)
Transitions from Quadrant IV (Dominance) through £20k, £25k, £30k, and £35k/QALY
